main_text.p: Signiferi emergunt, quàm spira, æqualiter orbem
Quæ secat, ex æquóque à cardine distat utróque,
Hunc rite obliquum signorum dixeris ortum.
main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI DE SPHÆRA, LIB. V.
main_text.p: Æte animi heroes seclis melioribus ortii, Qui primùm ingenij nixi permicibus aliis Perg, leues vetiti stellas iõig, orbibuorbes Implicitos, magni intrastis penetralia cœli Aust ingens facinus, penitus penitúsque repostas Natura in latebris cansat ratione sagaci Detexistis, & in caeca caligine mersi Certa ostendistis terris vestigia veri. Non caeca ambitio vobis, non blanda voluptas, Non vigiles curæ, non luxus pallida tabes, Sublimes fregêre animos, quin inuia rerum Sensibus humanis mentis penetraret acumen, Eque deum arcanis adytis per secula longa Astrorum eruerét cassas interpréte leges. Ergo nec imperium vos formidabile lethi, Nec quæ cuncta domant longis oblivia seclis, Sub latebrisque suis & caeca nocte coercent. Sed procul obscuri tenebris ab inertibus Orci,

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic throughout the verse; marginal ornaments and show-through omitted. Some verse words in the first lines are heavily damaged and read with uncertainty (e.g. "iõig", "orbibuorbes", "Aust", "penitúsque"), and the decorated initial "M" is partly obscured. Several "[?]" marks were not added; the verse reading is best-effort.
